title: File no step per open PR; the Status tab's ledger gives each open PR its next act and owner (consultant pick; not owner-typed)
ruling: Consultant pick, 00:29 CST Nov 16, answering triage 8's 00:27 CST question: file no step per open PR, because a step per PR would be record churn. Each open PR's owner and next act now come from the ledger on the page's Status tab (decision pr-ledger: `merge --reviewed --json` under the live file's `ledger` key; published 12:57 CST Nov 18 after PR 3649 merged). It replaces the open-PR map plan, which is retired. Goal item 3 read as met by its own words (live REST 00:27 CST Nov 16: 0 open PRs on a branch that matches an open step lacking a pr). Not owner-typed; undoable.
